connector.name: Raven - Solana Token Verification
connector.registryDescription: Solana token-launch verification for AI agents - deterministic, replayable, returns 'unknowable'.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package raven-verify-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the billybotticelli4u-collab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: RAVEN_SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Your Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Supplied by you, never taken from a caller. Without it, every call returns 'unknowable' rather than failing.
